# Device and platform integration {#device-and-platform-integration}

The APIs Shopify lists under device and platform integration, and the types only they use. On this page: [`PosApi`](#posapi), [`ScannerApi`](#scannerapi), [`WebVitalsApi`](#webvitalsapi).

<div class="ab-type ab-section">

<div class="ab-head">

## `PosApi` {#posapi}

<div class="ab-kind">interface</div>

</div>

<div class="ab-members">

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">cart</span>: <a href="#poscart">PosCart</a></code></p>

<llm-only>

`cart: PosCart`

</llm-only>

Provides methods to read and modify the current POS cart, including line items, discounts, customers, and properties.

</div>

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">close</span>: <a href="#posclose">PosClose</a></code></p>

<llm-only>

`close: PosClose`

</llm-only>

Closes the app and returns to the POS screen.

</div>

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">device</span>: <a href="#posdevice">PosDevice</a></code></p>

<llm-only>

`device: PosDevice`

</llm-only>

Returns information about the POS device, including its name and serial number. Rejects when the host does not answer, or answers without a device.

</div>

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">location</span>: <a href="#poslocation">PosLocation</a></code></p>

<llm-only>

`location: PosLocation`

</llm-only>

Returns information about the current POS location, including its ID, name, address, and status. Rejects when the host does not answer, or answers without a location.

</div>

</div>

<div class="ab-foot">

<span class="ab-foot-part">Used in: [useAppBridge()](/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)</span>

</div>

</div>

<div class="ab-type ab-section">

<div class="ab-head">

## `ScannerApi` {#scannerapi}

<div class="ab-kind">interface</div>

</div>

<div class="ab-members">

<div class="ab-member">

<p class="ab-sig"><code v-pre><span class="ab-name">capture</span>(): Promise&lt;<a href="#scannerpayload">ScannerPayload</a>&gt;</code></p>

<llm-only>

`capture(): Promise<ScannerPayload>`

</llm-only>

Opens the device camera to scan a barcode. Returns a Promise that resolves to a `ScannerPayload` containing the scanned data. A new call to `capture` rejects a pending call with an `AbortError`.

</div>

</div>

<div class="ab-foot">

<span class="ab-foot-part">Used in: [useAppBridge()](/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)</span>

</div>

</div>
